official_price_scope: Prices come from OpenAI's public pricing documentation. If the page or network is unavailable, the last successful snapshot is kept. USD prices are converted using this rate.
official_price_sync_help: Read model prices from OpenAI's official pricing documentation. This only calculates an internal reference value; it does not change channel ratios or member quotas.
request_content_scope: Admin only. Payloads are redacted and kept to 64 KB by default. Use this to review member requests alongside RPM and Token metrics; it is not a misconduct verdict.
request_repeat_alert_scope: Shown when one member sends the same request content repeatedly. Normal retries and batch jobs can do this, so confirm it against workspace, RPM, Tokens and the request body before acting.
Search by username, name, email, or key: Search by username, name, email, or key name...
usage_scope_privacy: Statistics do not read prompt bodies or keys. The AI assistant sends only reviewed data after administrator consent. Only retained logs can be counted. Usage and reference value alone cannot measure performance.
usage_scope_records: Counts saved consumption, error and refund log records, not login events. Billing adjustments and retries can add records: these are not distinct requests or verified successes. Tokens do not measure work output. Charges and refunds are raw quota units, not currency.
value_cost_scope: Register verified bills once. Costs are recognized in full on their entered date, without daily proration. Unregistered cost does not mean no cost.
value_data_scope: Only retained consumption ledger entries are covered, not all unique successful requests or upstream attempts. Errors and refunds do not add tokens again. Estimated usage, ambiguous cache and special billing stay unpriced. Unverified usage is not proof of actual upstream counts. No inferred project attribution.
value_formula: Reference value = disjoint input, output and cache token categories times their respective CNY-per-million rates. Internal quota units are not currency.
value_nonprofit_scope: Non-profit internal accounting. Reference value is not revenue, profit or employee output. Registered costs may be incomplete. Unpriced records are not zero-cost. Cache is already included in normalized input.
value_price_scope: Reference prices do not modify quotas or access. Blank cache rates mean unknown; zero means confirmed free. Effective versions match call time; channel-specific prices take precedence. Live reports can change with new prices; archived snapshots do not. Tiered pricing is not automated.
value_void_scope: Voiding excludes this cost from live reports but retains an audit row. Existing archives do not change.
